title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Special Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Special Edition Pre Filled Pods offer a simple but satisfying duo for the Elf Bar Dual 10K. One pod delivers juicy, fresh Watermelon while the other features sweet-tart Cherry for a rounded, classic fruit combo. Each 2ml pod includes a 5ml refill reservoir for extended vaping, supported by the Dual 10K internal refill system. Special Edition is ideal for those who enjoy familiar flavours with broad appeal. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
